description: WRITE: permanently delete a finished (transcribed or failed) job with its media and transcript. This cannot be undone. A job still in progress cannot be deleted. DELETE /jobs/{id}.

job_id.description: Rev.ai job id (the `id` from revai_submit_job or revai_list_jobs).

name: revai_delete_job
title: Delete job

description: The Rev.ai account behind the token: email, free, purchased, total and invoiced balance (USD) and whether HIPAA is on. GET /account.
name: revai_get_account
title: Get account and balance

description: Captions for a transcribed job as SRT (default) or WebVTT. Long files are paged by character: repeat with next_offset until it is null. For multichannel jobs pass speaker_channel. GET /jobs/{id}/captions.

job_id.description: Rev.ai job id (the `id` from revai_submit_job or revai_list_jobs).

max_chars.description: Most characters to return in one reply, 1000-20000 (default 15000).

offset.description: Start position from the previous reply's next_offset (default 0).

speaker_channel.description: Channel to caption, for jobs submitted with speaker_channels_count.

name: revai_get_captions
title: Get captions

description: One transcription job by id: status (in_progress, transcribed, failed), timestamps, duration, language, failure reason. Poll this until status is transcribed. GET /jobs/{id}.

job_id.description: Rev.ai job id (the `id` from revai_submit_job or revai_list_jobs).

name: revai_get_job
title: Get job status

description: The summary of a transcribed job. It exists only if the job was submitted with summarization_type. Paged by character like revai_get_transcript. GET /jobs/{id}/transcript/summary.

job_id.description: Rev.ai job id (the `id` from revai_submit_job or revai_list_jobs).

max_chars.description: Most characters to return in one reply, 1000-20000 (default 15000).

offset.description: Start position from the previous reply's next_offset (default 0).

name: revai_get_summary
title: Get transcript summary

description: The transcript of a transcribed job. format=text (default) is plain text with speaker labels and timestamps; format=segments is a list of {speaker, start, end, text} per speaker turn (seconds). Long transcripts are paged: repeat with next_offset until it is null. GET /jobs/{id}/transcript.

group_channels_by.description: Multichannel jobs only: how to group words into turns.

job_id.description: Rev.ai job id (the `id` from revai_submit_job or revai_list_jobs).

max_chars.description: Most characters to return in one reply, 1000-20000 (default 15000).

offset.description: text: character position; segments: segment index. Use the previous reply's next_offset (default 0).

name: revai_get_transcript
title: Get transcript

description: List transcription jobs from the last 30 days, newest first: id, status (in_progress, transcribed, failed), name, duration, language, failure reason. Page with starting_after = the previous reply's next_starting_after. GET /jobs.

starting_after.description: Return jobs older than this job id (exclusive), from next_starting_after.

name: revai_list_jobs
title: List transcription jobs

description: WRITE: start an asynchronous machine transcription job for an audio or video file at a public URL. It uses Rev.ai credit (free credit first). Returns the job with status in_progress; then poll revai_get_job and read the result with revai_get_transcript. Human transcription is not offered. POST /jobs.

delete_after_seconds.description: Delete the job and its data this many seconds after it completes.

forced_alignment.description: More accurate per-word timestamps (en, fr, it, de, es).

language.description: Spoken language as an ISO 639-1 code (en, en-us, en-gb, es, fr, de, ...). Default en.

media_url.description: Direct download URL of the audio or video file. Rev.ai fetches it; it must be reachable without login.

metadata.description: A note stored with the job and returned with it (for example your own reference).

speaker_channels_count.description: Number of audio channels with one speaker each. Billed per channel.

speakers_count.description: Number of speakers, if known (English, Spanish, French); improves speaker labels.

summarization_type.description: Also create a summary, read later with revai_get_summary.

verbatim.description: Keep every false start and disfluency (default true for machine jobs).

name: revai_submit_job
title: Submit transcription job
